brand.name: Deadwood Tobacco Co.
brand.description: Not on the site at all - confirmed absent from the site's full 112-brand index. CORRECTION TO AN INITIAL ASSUMPTION: this is NOT a Black Label Trading Company sub-line (that was the starting hypothesis, ruled out by research - no source connects Deadwood to BLTC at all). It is 'Deadwood Tobacco Co.,' produced/distributed by Drew Estate, rolled at La Gran Fabrica Drew Estate, Esteli, Nicaragua. Started as a South Dakota retail-exclusive brand and went national via Drew Estate around 2016. Sold as 'Deadwood by Drew Estate.' The brand's 4 core blends ('the Wild Bunch') are Sweet Jane, Fat Bottom Betty, Crazy Alice, and Leather Rose, plus a newer 'Dominicana' sub-line (2025).
brand.founded_note: 2016 marks the national rollout via Drew Estate; the brand originated earlier as a South Dakota retail exclusive (exact year not confirmed).
brand.origin_country: Nicaragua (Esteli) - the newer 'Dominicana' sub-line uses Dominican tobacco instead, per its name; factory not independently confirmed for that sub-line.

line.name: Deadwood Crazy Alice
line.description: One of the 4 core Deadwood blends ('the Wild Bunch': Sweet Jane, Fat Bottom Betty, Crazy Alice, Leather Rose). Debuted 2014 per founder Vaughn Boyd.
line.binder: Unconfirmed - one source reports Indonesian, but this conflicts with other retailer descriptions and was not resolved to a single answer.
line.filler: Nicaraguan (exact sub-origin undisclosed in sources checked)
